styles.name: Editorial UI
styles.desc: You, cut out onto a solid colour set that changes on every beat, with huge serif words behind your head. Cuts back to your room for prompt bars, checklists and a countdown. Bold and premium.

styles.name: Clean Talk
styles.desc: You, full frame and natural. One white word at a time at chest height, a small 3-line title, one or two big gold keywords and a couple of small cards. Calm and credible.

styles.name: Motion editorial
styles.desc: Animated graphics fill the top half (kinetic words, a circled number, a lab sheet, a gauge, a calendar) and you sit in a rounded card below. A magazine in motion.

styles.name: Split deck
styles.desc: Cards on the top half, you on the bottom half, short captions on the seam. A bold hook card, a name card, checklists that tick as you speak. Built for teaching.

styles.name: List stack
styles.desc: A numbered list builds above your head as you say each item. The item you're on lights up and the numbers never move. Made for '5 things' reels.

styles.name: Floating cards
styles.desc: Small frosted cards pop in around you on the exact word, plus one big word behind your head. Warm and bright, one word of caption at a time.

styles.name: Carousel slide-up
styles.desc: One cream card per point slides up over the lower half on each cut, like swiping a carousel. A static title on top, no captions. Short and punchy.

styles.name: Desk demo
styles.desc: Cuts from you to a phone-filmed screen (a lab portal, an app, a calendar) where a cursor clicks and highlights what you're talking about. Real and hands-on.
